exposure: Number of trained surgeons, anaesthesiologists, and obstetricians (SAOs) per 100,000 people
Number of perioperative providers (including clinical officers and nurse anaesthetists) per 100,000 people
outcome: Number of Bellwether operations (Caesarean sections, laparotomies, and external fixation for bone fractures) per 100,000 people
cohort: The study assessed 28 hospitals in the North Kivu province of the Democratic Republic of Congo.
finding: The surgical workforce in the Democratic Republic of Congo did not meet the LCoGS benchmark and was not an independent predictor of surgical capacity after adjusting for other hospital services.
